Package io.micronaut.dev.test

@NullMarked package io.micronaut.dev.test
Running tests in development mode: the runner contract, with a JUnit Platform runner built in, the events a run streams, and the JUnit XML reports written from them.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
graemerocher
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    io.micronaut.dev
    The development mode launcher: MicronautDevMain starts an application behind a reloadable class loader and the DevRuntime recompiles, restarts and reports as sources and resources change.
    io.micronaut.dev.test.report
    The live HTML report of test mode: adding this module to the development runtime classpath writes a page of the latest results, which updates as tests run when the LiveReload server serves it.
  • Class
    Description
    Cancellation
    Asks a run to stop early, as when a change arrives while it runs.
    JUnitPlatformTestRunner
    Runs tests on the JUnit Platform, with every engine on the launch classpath: Jupiter, Spock, Kotest, or Pyronaut's pytest engine.
    JUnitXmlReportWriter
    Writes the JUnit XML reports of a run, the format CI servers, IDEs and the build tools read: one TEST-<class>.xml per class in the Ant and Surefire shape, a testsuite of testcases with their classname, time, failure, error or skip, and captured system-out and system-err.
    TestEventListener
    The events of a run, from which every report is built.
    TestEventListeners
    Combines listeners into one that calls each in turn, and loads the report listeners registered as services.
    TestFailure
    Why a test failed.
    TestId
    One test of a run, as reports name it.
    TestOutcome
    How a test ended and how long it took.
    TestOutput
    The stream a test wrote to.
    TestReportListener
    A report of the runs, registered as a service: an HTML renderer, an IDE bridge, a terminal UI.
    TestResults
    The latest result of every test, across the runs a report sees, so that a report holds each class's latest results rather than only those of the last run.
    TestResults.Applied
    What a finished run changed.
    TestResults.Result
    The latest result of a test.
    TestRunner
    Runs tests, streaming what happens.
    TestRunRequest
    What a runner runs.
    TestRunStarted
    A run starting.
    TestRunSummary
    What a run did.
    TestSelection
    Which tests a run runs.
    TestStatus
    How a test ended.
